{{Quote|It’s named for a General Chakham who was one of Thaal’s boosters after he defected from the Empire, but it may be noteworthy that General Chakham’s daughter, Norena, was one of the original Pop-Dogs and is a newly minted general herself.|Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Norena Chakham''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Army]] and the daughter of General [[Chakham]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Norena was one of the original [[Pop-Dogs]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] unit that stayed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] and conducted guerrilla warfare against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. She was promoted to general sometime after.<ref name="MK" />
